Blackwire's read-only startup preparation idle check follows the public process
enumeration pattern and layout checks in itsPLK/ps5-payload-manager:
https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-payload-manager

The upstream GPLv3 license is retained in ps5-payload-manager-LICENSE. Preserve
this attribution, the applicable upstream license and source obligations when
distributing an integrated build. This is an ordinary process observation used
during owned startup-file preparation; it does not require a separate manager
service or introduce another game reader.
